fields.NARRATIVE: Tubes load in seconds and feed one part every 0.8 seconds, so the insertion head never waits. Four speed settings let you match the feeder to the head instead of throttling the head to the feeder.

fields.HERO_MEDIA: STF1003 tube feeder loaded with component tubes, 3/4 view or muted looping MP4
fields.MARQUEE_MEDIA: tube loading / part advance / 0.8 s cycle / tube changeover / HMI or controller / integration on an inserter
